purpose: Freeze the chronology-safe XBRL semantics used to reconstruct already-approved Smart Money components before any 4-quarter company values or future returns are examined.

fii_holding_change_pp_4q.normalization_note: The approved FII field is normalized to the NSE shareholding taxonomy's institutional Foreign Portfolio Investor category; this is a source-label normalization, not a new scoring feature.
fii_holding_change_pp_4q.excluded_reason: Generic FPI member is not combined or substituted because both candidates were viable in the mapping probe and post-value selection would risk double counting or semantic drift.

quarter_history_rule: Require at least five distinct chronology-safe shareholding periods ending on or before the anchor; use the latest observation and the fifth-latest observation. Revisions known after the anchor are prohibited.
ambiguity_rule: Any period with multiple incompatible aggregate facts for the locked member/fact pair is missing, not averaged or selected.
missing_data_rule: No imputation and no zero substitution.
promoter_component: NOT_PART_OF_THIS_MAPPING_LOCK; prior promoter evidence remains contextual and may be evaluated only as a separately reported extension.
